tier_reason: Tier unchanged (C). Enricher e111 (2026-10-05) re-ran the README harness on PyPI wheels (opencodecs 0.5.0, imagecodecs 2026.8.16, Python 3.12, 4-vCPU Xeon container) and found harness flaws behind two row groups: the harness passes the output size to opencodecs' LZW and PackBits decoders but calls imagecodecs lzw_decode(b) and packbits_decode(b) without out=, so imagecodecs runs an extra size pre-pass (LZW 2.71-2.80x as harnessed vs 2.15-2.17x like-for-like; PackBits 1.79-1.85x vs 1.02x, so the PackBits row is a harness artifact); and the imagecodecs manylinux wheel's libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 is built without SIMD (0 ymm and 0 pmaddwd instructions vs 4133 and 565 in opencodecs' copy), so the Linux JPEG 3.91x/1.80x rows measure baseline packaging (Windows is at parity). Deflate/PNG rows use imagecodecs' zlib path; imagecodecs.deflate_encode (libdeflate) is at parity (519 vs 537 ms, identical bytes).

corrections.claimed_speedup: README 'Codecs against imagecodecs' (opencodecs 0.5.0 vs imagecodecs 2026.8.16; Mac / Linux / Windows): TIFF-flavor LZW decode 3.33x / 3.07x / 2.94x and LZW encode 1.33x / 1.32x / 1.49x (own kernels, single-threaded); the enricher's like-for-like re-run (imagecodecs given out=) gives LZW decode 2.15-2.17x. PackBits decode 3.32x / 2.81x / 1.52x is a harness artifact (1.02x like-for-like). PNG RGB uint8 level 6 encode 3.45x / 3.68x / 1.12x and deflate level 6 encode 2.69x / 2.58x / 2.61x compare libdeflate against imagecodecs' zlib path; against imagecodecs.deflate_encode (libdeflate) it is parity (519 vs 537 ms, identical bytes). JPEG quality 90 encode 2.68x / 3.91x / 0.97x and decode 1.56x / 1.80x / 1.01x: the Linux rows reflect imagecodecs' manylinux libjpeg-turbo being built without SIMD; Windows is at parity. Rows marked 'opencodecs threaded' (several threads vs one): JPEG 2000 lossless encode 8.05x / 4.66x / 2.73x and decode 7.64x / 4.57x / 2.71x; JPEG XL 2.30x to 10x; BC7 decode 11x / 5.47x / 4.09x and BC1 decode 4.45x / 1.79x / 2.27x (vendored bcdec plus threads, not own kernels; below 1x per core, JPEG 2000 Linux encode about 0.63x per core). Many rows are at 0.72x to 1.05x (zstd, lz4, brotli, blosc2, lzma, bz2, snappy, WebP, QOI, JPEG-LS, ZFP). README 'TIFF against tifffile' (4096x4096 uint16 tiled deflate+predictor): Linux 4.2x one reader at defaults, 1.4x forced single thread, 10.0x with 8 concurrent readers; Mac 3.3x / 1.1x / 3.9x; single-thread cells 0.95x to 2.4x.
